description: Delete one or more constraints. Every id is checked before anything is removed, so a bad id leaves the scene untouched. Deleting puts each child back where it was when its constraint was created, unless that constraint had reset_position/reset_rotation/reset_scale turned off. Nothing here touches Studio's undo stack, and nothing here is undoable from the Studio UI. Requires the NodesConstraints plugin.

id.description: one constraint id from studio_constraint_list, or an array of them

output.description: the remaining constraints, same shape as studio_constraint_list
